# VibeScan

> Passive web configuration checker and public leaderboard (built on Node.js with built-in node:sqlite and optional headless Chromium). Evaluates public websites across 6 domains: Security, Privacy & GDPR, Performance (CWV lab), Accessibility, SEO, and Code Hygiene.

## Overview
VibeScan runs automated passive checks and produces 0–100 scores and grades (A–F). In public mode, full finding details remain in memory only for the active browser session; only numeric summary scores, tech-stack tags, and user-submitted claims are persisted to the leaderboard database.

- [Public Leaderboard](https://your-domain.example/)
- [Leaderboard Index](https://your-domain.example/leaderboard)
- [Health Check](https://your-domain.example/api/health)

## Audit Domains
- **Varnost (Security)**: TLS certificate and cipher inspection, HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, COOP/CORP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite), DNS checks (SPF, DMARC, CAA, DNSSEC), and passive port/CVE lookup via Shodan InternetDB.
- **Zasebnost & GDPR (Privacy & Compliance)**: Cookies and third-party tracker requests before user consent, CMP banner detection, third-party host jurisdiction hints (EU/US), and basic legal notice links.
- **Hitrost (Performance & CWV lab)**: Headless Chromium CDP lab metrics (LCP, CLS, TBT as a lab proxy for responsiveness, FCP, TTFB, payload size, and Brotli/Gzip compression) plus optional Google CrUX field data if an API key is configured.
- **Koda (Frontend Hygiene)**: Render-blocking scripts, public JS bundle secret-pattern scan, third-party SRI coverage, deprecated markup checks, HTML size, and broken links.
- **SEO**: Titles, meta descriptions, canonical links, OpenGraph tags, JSON-LD parsing, `robots.txt` AI crawler rules, `sitemap.xml`, and `/llms.txt` discovery.
- **Dostopnost (Accessibility)**: Custom static and Chromium-rendered DOM checks inspired by WCAG 2.2 (computed color contrast, form labels, accessible button/link names, image alt attributes, landmark regions, focus rules).

## Public API Endpoints
- `GET /` — Public interactive leaderboard and domain scanner UI.
- `GET /api/leaderboard` — Paginated leaderboard feed of scored domains.
- `GET /api/leaderboard/stats` — Summary counts and filter breakdowns.
- `GET /api/leaderboard/site/:host` — Stored numeric scores, score history, and builder claims for a specific domain.
- `POST /api/leaderboard/submit` — Queue a passive public domain scan (rate-limited per IP).
- `GET /api/health` — Service health and capability status.
